mission: The new seal stabilises. Not permanent, not a prison — living tissue embedded with the resonance's character. Three-part harmony at the Scar's base, flexible and dynamic, requiring renewal. The wound is contained, not erased. Ben feels the warmth spread outward; the wrongness resolves into a chord. Desh's chrono runs correctly for the first time since arrival.
why_now: The climax needs its final image. Not a victory monument — a living containment. The book has argued for ongoing relationship over permanent fix across twenty-six chapters, and the seal has to demonstrate that argument in its behaviour.
conflict: The new seal is imperfect. It requires renewal, monitoring, institutional attention. It is not the permanent fix Torin offered or the liberation Veraine promised. It is a third option: ongoing relationship with a problem that can be managed but not solved.
turning_point: The lattice reforms around the wound as living tissue rather than rigid grid. The resonance's character stays embedded. The seal needs tending because it is alive.
opening_hook: Ben feels the warmth spread outward from the resonance point and the wrongness — the constant background note he's been hearing for months — begins to quiet. Not silence. A chord resolving.
closing_hook: The Scar is still there. Thinner. The wound is contained, not erased. The new seal hums with three distinct frequencies — and Ben can feel all of them. He's part of it now. Not a prisoner. A note in a chord.
emotional_trajectory: The quiet after storm -> the new seal forming -> the bittersweet realization of ongoing connection

stakes.personal: Ben permanently connected to the new seal — relationship, not imprisonment
stakes.interpersonal: The resonance trio's bond made structural — their harmony is the seal's foundation
stakes.external: The wound contained. The galaxy safe. For now. With conditions.

setting: Veranthos — the valley, the Scar, the new seal forming
sensory_details: The wrongness quieting — the long background note resolving into a chord; the new seal's character arriving as living tissue, flexible and warm; the Scar thinning but persisting; Desh's grief-without-an-object lifting, chrono running correctly, temperature consistent; the valley quiet in a way it has not been since the book began
action_beats: Ben feels the warmth spread outward from the resonance point as the new seal forms — living tissue, not rigid grid
The Scar thins but persists — the wound contained, not erased, the new seal humming with three-part harmony
Desh checks his chrono and it runs correctly for the first time since arrival — the grief-without-an-object lifting
notes: The new seal's living quality is the book's structural argument made physical — it responds to relational harmony, which means Ben's sensation is literal rather than poetic. Rotate Force-wrongness / resonance vocabulary fully into the living-tissue and chord family for this scene; do not reuse handrail or flat-note. Desh's chrono running right is the non-Force-user's validation of the lattice's return — small, specific, visible. Anti-pattern: no speech from Ben about the seal's meaning; the reader has earned the recognition.
